variation: Standing bilateral rope triceps pushdown, single fixed high pulley
camera: Fixed front three-quarter view facing right, both hands distinct and full selected/unselected stack visible.
anchors: Shoes, feet, torso, shoulders, upper arms, machine base, fixed pulley, guide rods and unselected plates. Elbows stay by ribs.
equipment: One complete cable machine, high fixed pulley, taut cable and two-ended rope. Twelve identical plates total; exactly four selected, eight stay on the base. Fixed seatless tower; identical rope length and knobs.
secondary: No additional prime mover to highlight
stabilisers: Subtle forearm grip and trunk emphasis only; legs, chest and biceps remain white-grey.

states.body: Start with elbows bent around 90 degrees, rope ends held high in front of torso.
states.equipment: Cable taut, both hands wrapped around separate rope ends; fixed tower and guide rods do not move.
states.cableAndStack: Four selected plates remain rigid as one block: payout 0 mm, gap 20 mm. Eight unselected plates remain at the base.

states.body: Set elbows by the sides, begin a small downward movement.
states.equipment: Cable taut, both hands wrapped around separate rope ends; fixed tower and guide rods do not move.
states.cableAndStack: Four selected plates remain rigid as one block: payout 20 mm, gap 40 mm. Eight unselected plates remain at the base.

states.body: Extend elbows, rope ends move towards the waist.
states.equipment: Cable taut, both hands wrapped around separate rope ends; fixed tower and guide rods do not move.
states.cableAndStack: Four selected plates remain rigid as one block: payout 100 mm, gap 120 mm. Eight unselected plates remain at the base.

states.body: Continue elbow extension, upper arms stay fixed.
states.equipment: Cable taut, both hands wrapped around separate rope ends; fixed tower and guide rods do not move.
states.cableAndStack: Four selected plates remain rigid as one block: payout 200 mm, gap 220 mm. Eight unselected plates remain at the base.

states.body: Both elbows extended, rope ends separate naturally beside upper thighs; both hands visible.
states.equipment: Cable taut, both hands wrapped around separate rope ends; fixed tower and guide rods do not move.
states.cableAndStack: Four selected plates remain rigid as one block: payout 300 mm, gap 320 mm. Eight unselected plates remain at the base.

states.body: Controlled partial return; elbows bend, upper arms remain by ribs.
states.equipment: Cable taut, both hands wrapped around separate rope ends; fixed tower and guide rods do not move.
states.cableAndStack: Four selected plates remain rigid as one block: payout 80 mm, gap 100 mm. Eight unselected plates remain at the base.

loopBoundary: Continue the return from payout 80 mm to 0 mm while selected-stack gap falls from 100 mm to the 20 mm starting gap. No cable slack or moving fixed parts.

cable.routing: Handle cable passes over one fixed high pulley to the selected stack. Payout measured along this physical route.
